image_description: Three disposable lighters arranged in a row against a white background. The left lighter is purple with a blue gradient and feather design, showing the top mechanism. The center lighter is fully visible with a vibrant multi-colored feather graphic on a blue/purple body and a silver metal top guard. The right lighter is solid purple, showing only the side profile of the plastic casing.

artifact_observations.location: Feather graphic on center and left lighters
artifact_observations.reasoning: The feather texture has a slightly 'painted' or digital noise appearance rather than a crisp printed decal look. Edges of the feather blend softly into the plastic background, suggesting potential AI generation artifacts in texture synthesis.

The reflections underneath the lighters are inconsistent. The center lighter has a distinct reflection, but the rightmost solid purple lighter has a very faint, blurry shadow/reflection that doesn't match the lighting intensity of the others. The left lighter's reflection is also somewhat disconnected from the base.

artifact_observations.location: Top metal guard of the left lighter
artifact_observations.reasoning: The perforations in the metal windguard of the leftmost lighter appear slightly irregular and less defined compared to the center one, possibly due to angle or minor generation blur.
